note: Hu et al. (2024) observed that SCAF4 variants in domain-encoding and upstream exons have a strong association with epilepsy.

evidence.text: Previously reported SCAF4 variants were systematically reviewed, showing that variants located in domain-encoding exons and upstream exons exhibited a strong association with epilepsy.

source.title: SCAF4 variants are associated with epilepsy with neurodevelopmental disorders
source.quote: The variants in the domain-encoding exons and upstream exons exhibited a strong association with epilepsy.
